metaTitle: Custom Small Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom small lanyards and badges for your team. Perfect for ID cards and keys. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Small lanyards and badges are ideal for environments where a full-length lanyard can get in the way, such as labs, kitchens, or retail floors. These compact options, like the 3/8" or 5/8" knit-in styles, keep ID cards and keys close without dangling. They work well with badge reels and breakaway clasps for added safety. Choose a smaller width for a more professional, low-profile look that still delivers full branding impact.
heroAltText: Custom small lanyards and badges with printed logos, perfect for ID cards and keys in professional settings.
